messages:
alex: Quick check 

We need the final asset list + embargo plan for the marketplace launch. Dropping current asks here.
toni: Can someone paste the embargo windows and which partners need explicit quote approval?
sam: Timeline (draft): blog + landing 2029-05-03 09:00 PT, press outreach 2029-05-03 08:30 PT (tiered), marketplace listing 2029-05-03 10:00 PT. Partners go live same day unless they request staggered times.
grace: VoltEdge (hardware) needs hero image (4k) + 140-char quote by 2029-04-25 EOD. Theyre also asking for logo treatment guidance.
viktor: SI partners: Integrata (LOA signed) and SysForge (LOA pending). We need logos + 1-line integration summary by 2029-04-24 COB.
alex: Legal check: @sam do we have signed LOAs for VoltEdge and SysForge?
sam: VoltEdge LOA received. SysForge sent redline yesterday; legal expects reply by 2029-04-22 17:00 PT. If no fully executed LOA by 2029-04-23 12:00 PT, we hide SysForge on the landing.
toni: Marketing note: please don't include any unconfirmed partner in the hero. I have an alternate hero without SysForge ready. Also need GA + tracking params for partner clicks.
press-bot: embargo-template: https://drive.company/embargo-template (use partner_contact column) :page_facing_up:
grace: Partners can use our short quote template (will share). We should limit to 140 chars and include attribution.
viktor: Ops question: what happens if Dedicated pools aren't warmed for demo? last launch had cold-start issues.
sam: ops-bot: demo-route: primary -> dedicated pool, fallback -> hosted-playback endpoint if latency > 1.5s for 2 minutes. Metrics forwarded to console. :gear:
alex: Production checklist (final)
```
- hero image (high-res) by 2029-04-25
- partner logos (svg, png) by 2029-04-24
- LOA signed or hold tile by 2029-04-23
- partner quote <=140 chars by 2029-04-25
- integration blurb <=200 chars by 2029-04-24
- press contact (email + phone) by 2029-04-22
- GA tracking + UTM provided by 2029-04-26
- rehearsal: dry-run 2029-04-30 09:00 PT
```
toni: Finance: need co-marketing budget estimate for paid social by EOD 2029-04-20. Alex will own signoff.
grace: APAC reporter list  heads-up  one regional reporter requires a translated embargo in JP/EN. We'll need partner confirmation.
press-bot: rehearsal reminder scheduled 2029-04-30 09:00 PT. Join: https://meet.company/marketplace-rehearsal :megaphone:
alex: Thanks all. If partners request different embargo times, flag here and we'll decide case-by-case.
